comment: Single source of what is registered (VERIFY-AND-CHECKS.md D.5) plus ordering, parallelism, and failure policy. What a check needs (privilege, interactive, disruptive) is declared in the check module — see nix_check_contract.md §6.

blocks.name: code-invariants
blocks.comment: ARC 017. Static/offline gates over the repo's own code and its banked numbers. Deliberately last and deliberately not on_fail:halt — neither is a bootstrap floor component, and a code-invariant breach must not stop the environment checks that follow from being measured. check_derived_claims spawns `pytest --collect-only` (~2-4 s), which lengthens the boot unit; accepted because verify.py runs at boot and weekly Saturday 03:00, both outside any trading session. ARC 018: check_order_path_bans now AST-parses every .py under scripts/ to derive its own scope (D2.15) in addition to scanning the order path, and adds three AST retry-shape detections (D2.14). Measured at 0.16-0.18 s wall over three consecutive runs, so it does not materially lengthen the boot unit. No new check module was registered: the new checks/order_path_retry_reviewed.json is data (a per-site suppression registry), not a check, and registering it would break the registered_check_count claim.
